profile.headline: Software Engineer Sr. - Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
Software Engineer Sr. at Lockheed Martin
ATLO (Assembly, Test, Launch, and Operations) in the Space division
ATLS (ATLO Test Lab Services) in Sunnyvale and Palo Alto, CA

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed features for C# program that creates graphical interference reports of solar panels
• Updated backend legacy code for internal web tools used throughout the company
• Automated solution to orient and analyze 3D scans of solar panel surfaces

C# | PHP | Javascript | Python | Raspberry Pi | .NET

Lockheed Martin is the biggest U.S. government contractor that continues to innovate in aerospace, defense, and security with over 100,000 employees worldwide.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Full-stack developer for a web app that tracks inventory of manufacturing materials
• Created new software solutions for outdated mechanical systems in the solar panel division
• Integrated an Agile workflow system for our mechanical manufacturing center

PHP | SQL | HTML | CSS | jQuery | Raspberry Pi | Excel

Lockheed Martin is the biggest U.S. government contractor that continues to innovate in aerospace, defense, and security with over 100,000 employees worldwide. I had the privilege to work in the Space division at the Sunnyvale site during the release of two new satellites.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed automated test suite for nightly verification of company’s Admin UI
• Tested functionality of company products on different user platforms
• Performed other front end, back end, and manual testing of TV streaming content

Python | Selenium | Postman | Swagger | SoapUI | StormTest

Minerva Networks is a TV middleware company that empowers service providers to deliver you all your entertainment content across all networks and devices.

positions.title: Ophthalmic Technician
positions.description:
• Attended to multiple patients a day to treat all of their specialized eyecare needs
• Performed pre/post-examination tests on patients to measure and record ocular health data 
• Recorded patient data and results of eye exam tests into electronic medical database 
• Directed flow of patients throughout office to maximize efficiency

Auto Refractor | NCT | Visual Field and Acuity | OCT | ExamWriter | Contact Lens Training

Optima Optometry is an optometric private practice that serves its patients with the utmost care to solve all of their ocular health and optical needs.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Project Vietnam Foundation is a U.S. based nonprofit that works to treat patients in rural, remote areas of Vietnam with the same care and compassion of professional healthcare offices. I was a part of the first medical mission that included an optometry clinic.

• Worked with team of 120 medical personnel to provide healthcare for underdeveloped areas
• Served and handled crowd of over 1600 patients per day
• Trained other staff in use of optometric equipment and ophthalmic procedures
• Also worked in pharmacy, pediatric, and dentistry clinics
